references.text: Describes the peace offering (zebach shelamim) with an ox, which is the same type of sacrifice mentioned in Leviticus 9:18
Instructions for the peace offering with a sheep or ram, corresponding to the ram mentioned in the verse
Further regulations concerning the peace offering that Aaron performs for the people
Describes the sprinkling of blood around the altar, the same ritual performed in 9:18
Aaron's sons handed him the blood at the burnt offering, the same procedure repeated with the peace offering
Moses sent young men from Israel to offer peace offerings of oxen to the Lord
At Aaron's consecration, blood was sprinkled on the altar all around, the same ritual practice
Moses sprinkled the blood around the altar at the consecration, preparing for Aaron's service in chapter 9
The book of Hebrews refers to the sprinkling of blood on the tabernacle and its furnishings, pointing back to the Levitical sacrifice rituals
